method: Downloaded all five run-specific GitHub ZIP artifacts, inspected all five *_review.jpg contact sheets, all 40 original-source three-frame preview strips, and extracted and visually reviewed 30 MP4 frames at the midpoints of six real Kokoro narration blocks per video. Independently ran ffprobe and ffmpeg freezedetect scale=180:-2,n=-45dB,d=1.0 on all five MP4s.

observations: Block 5 includes source-embedded 'train-rattling' labels rather than clean footage.
Blocks 1-2 use very distant male displays; female inspection is not visually established.
Blocks 3-4 do not clearly show the narrated paws/claw grip.
Final block shows obstructed face and leaves rather than clearly establishing pantry/path/rest payoff.
Opening is ambiguous rock/animal, not clearly sea-otter grooming.
Blocks 2-3 use distant water or an almost invisible animal.
Payoff features small animals in an enclosure rather than clear coat care.
Action block uses distant birds and does not demonstrate inverted bill filtering.
Payoff shows upright heads, contradicting head-down feeding narration.
Hatchling block shows mostly empty sand.
Reef explanation block shows nearly empty water.

licensing: 40 Commons sources have author, sourcePage, and license URLs in config; this inspection does not independently re-certify external licensing.

code_repairs.note: Future renders now allocate word-caption timing within real Kokoro block durations; previous MP4s remain unapproved and have not been rerendered.
